name: Yamaha Road Star Warrior (XV1700PC)
engine: 1670 cc air-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Yamaha's sport cruiser. Fuel injected, belt drive and an aluminum frame. Early bikes had several recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2002 Warriors had a fuel tank mount recall (02V181), 2002-2003 bikes a transmission recall (03V309), and some later bikes a pickup coil wire recall (07V039).
A-002.reason: These are old, but a bike that missed one still has the fault.

recalls.what: Pickup coil lead wires can break while running, stalling the engine with no restart.
